Title: Azure Monitor Logs is now available in the US Gov Arizona region

Body.Content:
The Azure Monitor Logs feature is now available in the US Gov Arizona region. Azure Monitor Logs collects telemetry from a variety of sources and uses the query language from Azure Data Explorer to retrieve and analyze data.

Learn more about log queries in Azure Monitor and explore additional regional availability.
